title.narrative: Output 8.2. Increased capacity of member States to improve governance and sustainability of social protection systems

description.narrative:
(1) The Social Security Organization's (SSO) tripartite Board adopted a series of policy measures which aim at improving adequacy of benefits and strengthening sustainability of the Social Security Fund and the Workers Compensation Fund (WCF). These include an increase in the earnings ceiling used to calculate benefits and the introduction of indexation of benefits in payment. There was also approval of a change in the strategic allocation for SSO assets which reflect ILO recommendations and reinforcement of investment governance which strengthens sustainability.
(2) The SSO tripartite Board approved the creation of the Actuarial Bureau within the SSO following ILO technical advice on Terms of Reference, objectives and resourcing. This is expected to have a beneficial impact on the financial governance and policy decision making capacities of the SSO. (1) The ILO delivered technical support through briefs; meetings; several public presentations and prepared a report on Pensions. The ILO also undertook and delivered the first actuarial valuation report of the WCF, meeting the requirements of the ILO ISSA Actuarial Guidelines.
(2) The ILO prepared the justification and business case for the creation of the Unit; developed several options for its organizational design, including international best practices, assessment of staffing resources and budgets and delivered several presentations to the SSO to support recommendations.
